title: Live list filter
css: .filter-module{max-width:380px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:10px}.filter-module label{display:grid;gap:6px;font:600 14px system-ui}.filter-module input{padding:8px 10px}.filter-module [data-count]{margin:8px 0;color:#555;font:13px system-ui}.filter-module ul{margin:0;padding-left:22px}.filter-module li{padding:4px 0;font:14px system-ui}
js: const items=['Atlas','Bravo','Charlie','Delta','Echo','Foxtrot','Gamma','Hotel'];const input=root.querySelector('[data-filter]'),list=root.querySelector('[data-list]'),count=root.querySelector('[data-count]');const render=()=>{const q=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();const shown=items.filter(x=>x.toLowerCase().includes(q));list.replaceChildren(...shown.map(name=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=name;return li;}));count.textContent=shown.length+' of '+items.length+' shown';};input.addEventListener('input',render);render();api.log(4,'live filter mounted');
